'''mrwaltdog We'll Hndle This''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 WHT mrwaltdog LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Noticed that I probaly need some changes to this deck. Take a look and let me know.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Mostly I am looking for comment on what to change with this deck. I think I could cut down on characters but I am nor sure which ones or what to replace them with. Once again I have 10 sevens in the deck for combat. Also looking for an effect to start in place of Insurection & Aim High since it is mostly just a waste of space. Alon gthe lines of characters I put in most of the power house guys I own. The Yodas are in thee because they are jedias and the deck lives on them. The ones I do not have in there are Master Qui-Gon, The Original Obi-Wan Kenobi x2. Just let me know what changes should mostly likely be made.

Thankx
